finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If the timestamp is manipulated to include format specifiers, it could lead to unexpected behavior.
finding.assumptions: The timestamp is attacker-controlled or influenced, and the strftime function is used to format a string that could be used in an OS command.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: If the timestamp is manipulated to be larger than expected, it could lead to a buffer overflow in the microseconds array.
finding.assumptions: The timestamp is attacker-controlled or influenced, and the sprintf function is used to format a string into a fixed-size buffer.
